# requires: transfer
#
# A digest is an identity. Once the store holds a record that transferred these
# exact bytes and their file is still there at the size it proved, a second job
# for the same digest copies from that file before it opens any source of its
# own. B's only source does not exist, so the bytes B ends with can only have
# come from A's delivery.
#
# On 2026-09-06 the NAS fetched the same 386 MB from Hugging Face a second time
# over a file it already held, digest verified both times, because nothing
# looked at what the store had already proven. Every conformance instrument
# passed. C is the control: nothing has proven its digest, so it fails.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
run A alpha
submit B size=64 digest=good src=missing
run B beta
submit C size=64 digest=bad src=missing
run C gamma

# expect 2: ok state=transferred
# expect 2: done=64
# expect 4: ok state=transferred [DL-R28]
# expect 4: done=64 err=none
# expect 6: transfer-failed
